description: Main activity for an Android Wearable app that tracks speed using GPS, manages permissions, updates UI elements, and communicates location data to other components.

classes.name: WearableMainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for the wearable speed tracker app, handling GPS location updates, UI updates, permissions, and data communication.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up views, permissions, GoogleApiClient, and checks hardware features.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes location updates and disconnects GoogleApiClient when activity pauses.

methods.name: setupViews
methods.description: Initializes UI components and updates views based on permissions.

methods.name: onSpeedLimitClick
methods.description: Starts SpeedPickerActivity to change speed limit.

methods.name: onGpsPermissionClick
methods.description: Requests GPS permission if not already granted.

methods.name: updateActivityViewsBasedOnLocationPermissions
methods.description: Adjusts UI elements based on GPS permission status and GPS signal availability.

methods.name: updateSpeedInViews
methods.description: Updates speed and speed limit display, including color coding and blinking indicator.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Handles actions upon GoogleApiClient connection, requests location updates.

methods.name: requestLocation
methods.description: Creates and requests high-accuracy location updates.

methods.name: onLocationChanged
methods.description: Updates speed, UI, and logs when location changes.

methods.name: addLocationEntry
methods.description: Sends location data to data layer storage for synchronization.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from speed limit picker activity, updates preferences.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles GPS permission request results, updates permission state.

methods.name: hasGps
methods.description: Checks if device supports GPS hardware.
